about: The web-game-template revision this Factory is validated against. Golden runs, the SDK inspector's tests and every test that reads template files use a checkout of exactly this commit (scripts/wgflib/template.py). Change it only in a commit where both golden runs pass on the new revision (WGF_TEMPLATE_COMMIT=<sha> WGF_GOLDEN=1 bin/wgf test-core). This commit is 1f5dee2 (web-game-template main, 2026-09-24) plus one commit adding the golden-run ports under examples/*/wgf-golden/ and examples/wgf-golden-shared/.
